description: This PHP source file defines the class ExternalSourceEAPMAdapter, which extends ImportDataSource. It provides functionality to connect to external EAPM sources (like Google), load contact data via APIs, and expose an iterable interface for records. It appears to be part of the import framework in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, specifically handling external EAPM integrations.

classes.name: ExternalSourceEAPMAdapter
classes.description: A class that extends ImportDataSource to facilitate loading and iterating over contact data from an external EAPM source such as Google, using the EAPM and Connector framework.

methods.name: loadDataSet
methods.description: Loads contact data from the external EAPM source using the API factory and connector, populating internal record set and total record count.

methods.name: getHeaderColumns
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no specific header columns are provided.

methods.name: getTotalRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of records available from the external source.

methods.name: setSourceName
methods.description: Sets the source name, defaulting to the EAPM name.
